CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sentinel_normalized_legacy_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sentinel_candidate_blocks WHERE candidate_id=NEW.candidate_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy and shared candidate payloads cannot mix'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

SELECT sentinel_snapshot_bars.candidate_id,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.security_id,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.session,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.ticker,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.close_signal,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.close_unadjusted,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.open_unadjusted,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.volume,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.split_ratio,
    sentinel_snapshot_bars.dividend_per_share
   FROM sentinel_snapshot_bars
UNION ALL
 SELECT r.candidate_id,
    p.security_id,
    r.session,
    p.ticker,
    p.close_signal,
    p.close_unadjusted,
    p.open_unadjusted,
    p.volume,
    p.split_ratio,
    p.dividend_per_share
   FROM sentinel_candidate_blocks r
     JOIN sentinel_normalized_blocks b USING (block_sha256)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(b.canonical_payload::jsonb -> 'rows'::text) p(security_id text, session date, ticker text, close_signal double precision, close_unadjusted double precision, open_unadjusted double precision, volume double precision, split_ratio double precision, dividend_per_share double precision)
  WHERE r.kind = 'BARS'::text;

    sentinel_snapshot_benchmarks.bil_close_adjusted,
    sentinel_snapshot_benchmarks.bil_close_unadjusted

UNION ALL
 SELECT r.candidate_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sentinel_operational_evidence_ddl_changed()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$BEGIN
    -- Conservatively invalidate on every public-schema DDL command. This also
    -- covers ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER and function replacement.
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() WHERE schema_name='public') THEN
        UPDATE public.sentinel_operational_ddl_epoch SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE id=1;
        IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational DDL epoch is absent'; END IF;
    END IF;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sentinel_operational_revision_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP <> 'UPDATE' OR pg_trigger_depth() < 2
       OR NEW.scope <> OLD.scope OR NEW.incarnation <> OLD.incarnation
       OR NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational revision may only advance from its dependency trigger';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
